actionable_steps.citation: Foster love: eschew hatred — SSS Vol 27 (1994), 1994-04-11
actionable_steps.step: Reduce your desires to a minimum — confine them to the primary necessities of life: food, clothing, shelter.

actionable_steps.citation: Rise Above Body Consciousness — SSS Vol 36 (2003), 2003-04-02
actionable_steps.step: Put a ceiling on every desire; desires must stay under limit, never run wild.

actionable_steps.citation: From Annam To Ananda — SSS Vol 21 (1988), 1988-03-13
actionable_steps.step: Get absorbed in worthwhile activity — idleness lets the mind indulge in all kinds of desires.

actionable_steps.citation: Install padukas in your heart — SSS Vol 32 (1999), 1999-10-01
actionable_steps.step: Keep only the desires that are pleasing to God; let every desire be offered at His feet.

actionable_steps.citation: The Shiva in all — SSS Vol 12 (1973 - 74), 1974-02-20
actionable_steps.step: Burn your vices and bad habits into ash through discipline, and offer Shiva the ashes of desire's destruction.

definition.quote: Desire is the worst enemy and it has to be canalised and reduced with determination until it ceases to bother you.

discourses.citation: Foster love: eschew hatred — SSS Vol 27 (1994), 1994-04-11
discourses.quote: Desire is an unnecessary burden in your life's journey. You must reduce your desires to a minimum, as it may not be possible to give up desire totally. If you analyse the difference between God and man you will find that life plus desire is man and life minus desire is God.

discourses.citation: Install Rama Principle In Your Heart — SSS Vol 33 (2000), 2000-04-12
discourses.quote: Today's man likewise is bound by desire. When you give up desire, you can attain God.
'I want a house' is a legitimate desire and one should seek it. But it is greedy to possess two or more houses. Today greed is more prevalent among men than desire for necessities.

discourses.citation: Tame the mind and realise the Self — SSS Vol 26 (1993), 1993-05-20
discourses.quote: It is excessive desire that causes attachment and disappointment. Desire should be within limits. It should not become a hidden sickness.

make_it_real: Life plus desire is man; life minus desire is God. Lighten your luggage today.
title: Desire

vahinis.quote: To get free from such bondage, the mind should be trained not to dwell upon, desire, or dislike any object. It is the mind that binds and unbinds.
